policy.description:
[reflector]
url = "https://reflector.example:7483"
members = ["https://10.0.0.1:7483", "https://10.0.0.2:7483"]
Image policy (`policy.yaml`, at the default `verify.policy`). Empty: no file, so no policy.

source.description: Where the agent reads its config. `configMap`: the chart writes `toml`, `policy` and `trustedRoot` to a ConfigMap mounted as the directory `/etc/speculaire`. `host`: each node's own `/etc/speculaire` (read-only), and the three values below must stay empty.

toml.description: Agent config (`config.toml`), a TOML string: the agent's defaults apply to every key left out (`packaging/config.toml` in spnngl/speculaire lists them). A string, not a map, because Helm turns every number into a float. The reflectors get the same text after `role = "reflector"`, so `role` is chart-owned. Live keys reload within `config.poll_interval` after the kubelet syncs the ConfigMap (about a minute); restart keys need `kubectl rollout restart`. Set `reflector.url` for the agents to find their peers.

trustedRoot.description: Sigstore trusted root (`trusted_root.json`), a JSON string. Set it together with `verify.trusted_root = "/etc/speculaire/trusted_root.json"` in `toml`; empty: the agent fetches the public-good root over TUF.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts, for the agent and the `configure` init container.

extraVolumes.description: Extra volumes, for both DaemonSets (for example a node directory of `containerd`'s `config_path` other than `/etc/containerd/certs.d`, or CRI-O's `global_auth_file`).

fullnameOverride.description: Override the full resource name (default `<release>-<chart>`). The DaemonSets add `-agent` and `-reflector`.

tolerateAnnotation.description: Pod annotation that lets the runtime start the speculaire pods while the gate is down. Set the same key in the runtime's NRI validator: containerd `tolerate_missing_plugins_annotation` under `[plugins.'io.containerd.nri.v1.nri'.default_validator]`, CRI-O `nri_validator_tolerate_missing_plugins_annotation` under `[crio.nri.default_validator]`. Without it, a node whose runtime requires `speculaire` cannot restart the agent that serves the requirement. The chart sets it to `"true"` on both pods.

global.description: Global values are values that can be accessed from any chart or subchart by exactly the same name.

enabled.description: Mount the node's CA trust store read-only over the image's own (Alpine's Mozilla bundle), as the systemd install reads it: a CA added on the node (a private registry's, a TLS-inspecting proxy's) is then trusted for upstream registries. The agent loads roots like OpenSSL: the first bundle file found (`/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt` on Debian/Ubuntu, `/etc/pki/ca-trust/extracted/pem/tls-ca-bundle.pem` on Fedora/RHEL) and every file of `/etc/ssl/certs` and `/etc/pki/tls/certs`.

paths.description: Node directories mounted, each at the same path, when `enabled`. The default covers Debian/Ubuntu and Fedora/RHEL/Fedora CoreOS: there `/etc/ssl/certs` holds absolute symlinks into `/etc/pki/ca-trust/extracted`, which resolve inside the container, so that directory is mounted too (not all of `/etc/pki`: `tls/private` holds keys). A directory missing on the node is created empty (hostPath `DirectoryOrCreate`): keep only your layout's paths to avoid it.

digest.description: Image digest, only valid together with `image.tag`.

repository.description: Image repository, shared by the agents, the reflectors and the `configure` init container.

tag.description: Image tag. Empty: `appVersion` pinned by the digest recorded in `Chart.yaml`. When set, the chart digest is not applied; add `image.digest` to pin it.

livenessProbe.description: Liveness probe, `GET /livez`: the agent's watchdog (it answers while its event loop runs). A hung agent cannot drain, so the kubelet kills it after 5 s rather than `terminationGracePeriodSeconds`, and a new one runs within 40 s of the hang.

nameOverride.description:
yaml-language-server: $schema=values.schema.json
Override the chart name used in resource names and labels.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector, for both DaemonSets. Merged with the default `kubernetes.io/os: linux`: set that key to `null` to drop it.

podLabels.description: Extra pod labels, for both DaemonSets.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod security context. Overrides are merged onto these defaults. Root is required: the agent writes runtime config owned by root and connects to root-only sockets.

priorityClassName.description: Priority class name. The agent is a node component: without it, preemption can evict the agent the node's container starts depend on.

readinessProbe.description: Readiness probe, `GET /readyz`: ready once the gate and the mirror serve. It paces the rolling update.

digest.description: Reflector image digest, only valid together with `reflector.image.tag`.

tag.description: Reflector image tag on `image.repository`. Empty: the agents' image. An upgrade that changes the peer protocol sets this first, then `image.tag`: reflectors stay one minor ahead of the agents.

nodeLabel.description: Node label (key only) of the nodes that run a reflector instead of an agent. A reflector is an agent with `role = "reflector"` (it gates and mirrors its own node too). Nodes labelled `speculaire.spnngl.github.io/disabled` run neither.

resources.description: Resources, for the agent and the `configure` init container. No limit on purpose: an agent killed for memory blocks every container start on a node whose runtime requires `speculaire`. Like the other maps, `requests` merges with these defaults: set a key to `null` to drop it.

runtime.description: Container runtime of the nodes. It picks the node directories the pods mount (socket, runtime config, registry config, image store). Every node of the release runs the same runtime: install one release per runtime, split with `nodeSelector`. A wrong value fails the `configure` init container, which names both runtime sockets.

securityContext.description: Container security context, for the agent and the `configure` init container. Overrides are merged onto these defaults. No capability: root's file ownership is enough. On SELinux nodes that deny the runtime sockets to containers, set `seLinuxOptions: {type: spc_t}`.

create.description: Create the ServiceAccount. The pods do not use the Kubernetes API: its token is not mounted.

name.description: ServiceAccount name. Empty: `<fullname>` (or `default` when `create` is false).

startupProbe.description: Startup probe, `GET /livez` on the status listener (`metrics.address`, port 7482). Two minutes for the agent to load its cache and open its listeners.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Termination grace period. The agent drains its connections and exits within it.

tolerations.description: Tolerations, for both DaemonSets. Every taint by default: the agent gates every node's containers.

maxUnavailable.description: Nodes updated at once. While its agent restarts, a node pulls without the mirror and, if its runtime requires `speculaire`, starts no container.

type.description: DaemonSet update strategy, for both DaemonSets. There is no `maxSurge`: two agents on a node would compete for the host ports.
